title: What filtering saves: the same RL run on unfiltered prompts
purpose: Compare the production RL run with its one-key ablation on unfiltered math prompts (the run preempted in S06, which finished afterwards). In group-relative RL a group whose answers all get the same reward has zero advantage and teaches nothing.

checks.description: the ablation finished after it was re-admitted

checks.description: on unfiltered prompts a larger share of groups carries no learning signal
checks.because: Unfiltered prompts include ones the model always solves and ones it never does; every answer in such a group gets the same reward, so its advantage is zero.
